content.short: Halo is a cryptographic proving system that enhances trust and scalability for Zcash.
content.description: Halo is a cryptographic proving system designed to work with Zcash, removing the need for trusted setups and reducing the costs associated with ceremonies. By eliminating reliance on trusted setups, Halo provides a more confident basis for Zcash and a faster, cheaper foundation for ongoing development and privacy-preserving applications. Halo 2 builds on these advances, reinforcing its central role in zero-knowledge proofs and enabling scalable workflows across a range of use cases.
content.meta: Halo is a cryptographic proving system for Zcash that removes trusted setups. Discover Halo and other Zero Knowledge Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
